rationale: Production startup must not allow SYLION_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED=1 because that environment flag bypasses the global RateLimitMiddleware before request accounting. The change is a cross-cutting security startup guard and supports roadmap item PROD-P1-006 / A.5.

steps: Remove SYLION_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED from the production forbidden-value map in sylion.security.startup_check.
Remove or update the focused startup-check regression for rate-limit disabled production mode.
Run src/sylion-pipeline/tests/security/test_startup_check.py to confirm startup checks return to the previous behavior.

fidelity_test.description: Verify production startup fails when the global rate limiter bypass flag is enabled.
steps: Assert production with SYLION_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED=1 returns a StartupCheckResult failure.
Assert clean production with PostgreSQL URL and no disabled guards passes.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: Production refuses to start with rate limiting disabled and continues to allow dev/test bypasses outside production.
